title: Variable Importance Recovery in Tabular Foundation Models: A Simulation Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.28241v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In machine learning, identifying which variables contribute predictive information can be as important as predictive accuracy. Tabular foundation models have matched or exceeded the predictive performance of tuned gradient boosting trees on many small- and medium-sized tabular datasets. Yet their ability to recover population-level variable importance has received little attention. We design and conduct a Monte Carlo simulation study to compare variable importance recovery across tabular foundation models and established machine learning baselines. Our framework distinguishes multiple population estimands, pairs each one with an aligned model-agnostic importance estimator, and evaluates recovery in terms of ranking, support, and relative magnitude. Our results show that tabular foundation models are generally competitive with established machine-learning baselines in recovering population variable importance, and often more accurate. W

translated_title: 表格基础模型中的变量重要性恢复：一项模拟研究
translated_abstract: 在机器学习中，识别哪些变量贡献了预测信息可能与预测准确性同等重要。表格基础模型在许多中小型表格数据集上的预测性能已经达到或超过经过调优的梯度提升树。然而，它们在恢复总体层面变量重要性方面的能力却鲜受关注。我们设计并开展了一项蒙特卡洛模拟研究，以比较表格基础模型与成熟机器学习基线方法在变量重要性恢复方面的表现。我们的框架区分了多种总体估计目标，将每一个估计目标与相应的模型无关的重要性估计器配对，并从排序、支撑集和相对量级三个方面评估恢复效果。我们的结果表明，表格基础模型在恢复总体变量重要性方面总体上与成熟的机器学习基线方法具有竞争力，且往往更为准确。
tldr: 该论文通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究发现，表格基础模型在恢复总体层面变量重要性方面与成熟的机器学习基线方法相当，且往往更为准确。
en_tdlr: This Monte Carlo simulation study shows that tabular foundation models are generally competitive with—and often more accurate than—established machine learning baselines in recovering population-level variable importance.
